revision_summary: Two targeted fixes needed on rerun: (1) Schema citation correction — cherry_pick_moments[4] ('prior_contact_probe_miss') misapplies orphaned_flow, which is defined for customers with an EXISTING solar system, not a vague past event at a prior home; either drop the schema_reference or note there is no clean schema match. Similarly, observed_outcome.reasoning should cite protocols.adult_child_decision_maker instead of stretching protocols.spouse_decision by analogy — Ion's schema has a purpose-built protocol for a title co-owner/family member exactly like the mother in this call. (2) Add a transcript-quality caveat: the diarization in this call is unreliable in several stretches (e.g., 00:09-00:32 shows the same speaker label both asking and answering questions), and Stage 3 should flag this explicitly rather than building confident state-trajectory and rep-intent claims without acknowledging the noisy source. Additionally, surface the 03:53 'what's the name of the company' moment as its own cherry_pick_moments entry (currently only referenced inside another moment's reasoning) since it's the clearest direct evidence of the legitimacy gap. Minor: the credit-qualifier praise in cherry_pick_moments[2] should acknowledge the schema's own documented uncertainty (spencer_operator_note) about stated-credit reliability rather than calling it an unqualified positive baseline. No fabricated quotes of critical severity were found; the one flagged quote-check item is a trivial ts-boundary overlap, not a real fabrication.
